# Factory sensors with failure labels

A year of hourly sensor readings from six machines, with the degradation stage, remaining useful life, and the failures and work orders they lead to.

**Free to use, no attribution required, no signup.** Generated by [Misata Studio](https://www.misata.studio), not sampled from anyone's real data, so there is no personal information in here and nothing to anonymise.

| table | rows | columns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sites` | 1 | 5 |
| `assets` | 6 | 9 |
| `sensor_readings` | 52,560 | 13 |
| `failure_events` | 39 | 7 |
| `work_orders` | 63 | 8 |

52,669 rows in total.

## What is guaranteed about it

`INTEGRITY.txt` is the output of re-running the structural checks against these exact files.

- 52,560 hourly readings from 6 machines; 1.7% are labelled as failing within 24 hours
- 39 failures; in the 72 hours before 39 of them the machine had already left the healthy state
- Remaining useful life counts down by one hour per reading in 100% of consecutive readings (it resets at a repair)
- 63 work orders, 63 of them closed on or after they opened
- 10 of 10 structural checks pass (keys, foreign keys, date order)

## Make your own version

Open Misata Studio (https://www.misata.studio/app/new), describe what you need, and get a dataset shaped like yours with its own certificate. `RECIPE.json` shows how this one was built.
